name: AGE 04 - Meta Error Policy Watch - Read Only

parameters.query:
SELECT error_code, COUNT(*)::integer AS occurrences,
 MAX(reserved_at) AS last_seen,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('RESERVED','SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN','SUBMITTED'))::integer AS unsettled
 FROM age_dispatcher.reservation
 WHERE reserved_at >= now()-interval '30 days' AND error_code IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY error_code ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 100;
